title: 第23章 为陈曼解毒第24章 陈曼卖乖
content_zh:
叶开不解地问：“我怎么为她解毒？”
“用你的身体为她解毒啊。”
叶开连连摆手，“啊，这不行，我不能趁人之危！”
“这不叫趁人之危，这叫救人于水火之中。如果你不救她，她就会欲火烧身得不到发泄，最终变成一个废人！”
“可是她现在昏迷不醒，我也没办法征得她的同意啊！”
“为了救她的命，只能先斩后奏了，我相信，等她醒来以后，会理解你，感激你的！”
“只怕她会怨恨我。”
“和生命比起来，贞操什么的都不算什么！”
叶开摇头，“不行，我不能这么做，这违背了我的做人原则！”
王艳见叶开下不了决定，着急地催促道：
“来不及多想了，你看看她的脸多么红，火已经烧得很厉害了，再这么下去，五脏六腑都要被烧坏！”
叶开朝陈曼看去，只见她的脸红得就像火烧的一样，嘴里在说胡话。
看来确实是迫在眉睫了！
叶开也喝了一些药酒，浑身燥热，急需泻火。
但是他不想在陈曼不清醒的情况下对她做那些事情。
“你放心的干吧，等她醒来，我会向她解释清楚的！”
王艳把叶开推到陈曼身上，然后走出房间，把门关上了。
“我热，快点救我！”昏迷中的陈曼发出了呼救声。
情况已经非常紧急了，容不得叶开犹豫，他除去了陈曼的衣服。
一个洁白美丽的胴体出现在他的眼前，陈曼伸出双手抱紧了叶开。

……
王艳睡意全无，坐在客厅沙发上，倾听着西卧室的动静。
她很得意，终于把陈曼和张怀涛给拆散了！
也算报了被张有权霸占的一箭之仇。
她又感到痛苦，因为她喜欢的男人正在和别的女人忘情缠绵。
“嗯嗯嗯”的低吟声不断传来，刺激着王艳的心。
一个小时过去了，里面还没有停歇。
王艳眼睛看着电视，心里想的都是叶开。
是她自己把叶开推进别的女人怀抱，怪不得叶开。
王艳迁怒到张有权身上，她来到厢房门前，听见里面传来张有权的呻吟声。
这个老东西，怎么不早一点死！
王艳恨不能掐死张有权，但是她不能那么做，那是犯法，要掉脑袋的！
王艳在院子里转了一圈又回到客厅，里面安静下来了。
王艳的心情也平复了许多，一阵困意袭来。
她走进自己的房间，很快就睡着了。
叶开被一声尖叫惊醒，陈曼就在他旁边，睁大了惊恐的眼睛看着他。
“你怎么在这里，你侮辱了我，你是个色狼！”
陈曼疯狂地捶打着叶开的胸脯。
叶开既不制止，也不反抗，等到陈曼打累了，躺在那里喘息，
这才解释道：“你昨晚喝了两杯药酒，欲火烧身，就像发高烧一样，不停地说胡话。

如果不及时为你解毒，重则死掉，轻则变成傻子。
我是为了救你，迫不得已才这样做的。”
content_en:
Ye Kai asked puzzledly: "How can I detoxify her?"
"Use your body to detoxify her."
Ye Kai waved his hands repeatedly, "Ah, this won't work, I can't take advantage of others' danger!"
"This is not called taking advantage of others, this is called saving people from fire and water. If you don't save her, she will be so horny that she won't be able to vent her desires, and eventually become a useless person!"
"But she's unconscious now, and I can't get her consent!"
"In order to save her life, we can only kill her first and then kill her. I believe that when she wakes up, she will understand you and be grateful to you!"
"I'm just afraid she'll resent me."
"Compared to life, chastity is nothing!"
Ye Kai shook his head, "No, I can't do this, it goes against my principles of life!"
Seeing that Ye Kai couldn't make a decision, Wang Yan urged anxiously:
"It's too late to think about it. Look how red her face is. The fire is already very intense. If it continues like this, her internal organs will be burned out!"
Ye Kai looked at Chen Man and saw that her face was as red as fire and she was talking nonsense.
It seems that it is indeed imminent!
Ye Kai also drank some medicinal wine. His whole body was hot and he needed to relieve the fire.
But he didn't want to do those things to Chen Man when she was unconscious.
"Don't worry, I will explain it to her when she wakes up!"
Wang Yan pushed Ye Kai onto Chen Man, then walked out of the room and closed the door.
"I'm hot, help me quickly!" Chen Man, who was in a coma, cried out for help.
The situation was already very urgent, and Ye Kai could not tolerate hesitation, so he took off Chen Man's clothes.
A white and beautiful body appeared in front of his eyes, Chen Man stretched out his hands and hugged Ye Kai tightly.
…
Wang Yan was not sleepy at all, sitting on the sofa in the living room, listening to what was going on in the west bedroom.
She was very proud that she finally separated Chen Man and Zhang Huaitao!
It can also be regarded as revenge for being occupied by Zhang Quanquan.
She felt pain again because the man she liked was having an affair with another woman.
The low moans of "Yeah, yeah, yeah" kept coming, stimulating Wang Yan's heart.
An hour passed and there was still no rest inside.
Wang Yan looked at the TV, thinking about Ye Kai.
It was she who pushed Ye Kai into the arms of another woman, no wonder Ye Kai.
Wang Yan turned her anger on Zhang Quanquan. She came to the door of the wing and heard Zhang Quanquan moaning from inside.
Why didn't this old guy die earlier?
Wang Yan wished she could strangle Zhang Quanquan to death, but she couldn't do that. It was against the law and her head would be lost!
Wang Yan walked around the yard and returned to the living room. It became quiet inside.
Wang Yan's mood also calmed down a lot, and she felt sleepy.
She went into her room and fell asleep quickly.
Ye Kai was awakened by a scream, and Chen Man was right next to him, looking at him with wide, frightened eyes.
"Why are you here? You insulted me. You are a pervert!"
Chen Man beat Ye Kai's chest crazily.
Ye Kai neither stopped nor resisted. When Chen Man was tired from beating him, he lay there panting.
Then he explained: "You drank two glasses of medicinal wine last night, and you were burning with desire, just like you had a high fever, and you kept talking nonsense.
If you are not detoxified in time, you may die or become a fool at worst.
I did this out of necessity to save you. "
